identity.description: SE Ranking is an SEO platform (rank tracking, keyword research, backlinks, site audits) that offers a Data API and a Project API, plus a hosted MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: seranking.com/api describes the Data API and Project API of the SE Ranking SEO platform, matching the assignment. A separate SE Visible product also has API sections; it is not the subject here.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, used by the hosted MCP server at https://api.seranking.com/mcp. No OAuth flow was found for the REST Data or Project APIs.
auth.token_refresh: Not applicable for static API keys; no refresh flow documented in pages reviewed.
auth.scopes_notes: Data API and Project API use separate keys (created from the API Dashboard, selecting the type). The MCP server takes DATA_API_TOKEN and/or PROJECT_API_TOKEN per a mirrored README (not verified on the official repo).

access.production_restrictions: Data API access is tied to plan credits; API access lives with the master account, not sub-accounts. Enterprise rate limits/pricing go through sales.

resources: Data API: Backlinks, Domain Analysis, Keyword Research, AI Search, Website Audit, Account System
Project API: Project Management, Keyword Groups, Competitors, Backlink Checker, AI Results Tracker, Marketing Plan, Analytics Traffic
write_ops: Project management (create/manage projects) implied by Project API description; exact write endpoints not verified
api.rate_limits: Default requests-per-second limits, increasable by contacting support. A mirrored README (unofficial) cites 10 rps for Data API and 5 rps for Project API.
api.limitations: No first-party SDKs; integration via REST reference and Postman collection. Not every API endpoint is exposed through MCP. Webhooks not mentioned on pages reviewed. Write coverage not confirmed from official reference.

open_questions: Webhooks: not mentioned on seranking.com/api, /api/data/reference, or /api/how-to-get-api; unknown.

Conflict on plan inclusion: a search snippet from SE Ranking's Help Center says Essential and Pro plans do not include API access and need an add-on, while the how-to-get-api page says all listed plans include Data API access. Help Center page was not fetched; resolve with the API Dashboard or sales.

Base URL conflict: a search snippet for the Project API getting-started page cites https://api4.seranking.com/, while the OpenAPI repo says all four APIs are served from https://api.seranking.com. Current Project API host not verified.
Auth method for Project API: snippet says token via query parameter or Authorization header; not verified on the official getting-started page (fetch not completed).

Official GitHub MCP repo github.com/seranking/seo-data-api-mcp-server returned 404 to WebFetch; ownership and README unverified. Only mirrored README snippets (Data API token and Project API token env vars; 10 rps / 5 rps) were seen, so they are not official-source claims.
Community MCP servers exist (TeamDay-AI on Glama, guifreballester on LobeHub, mcpservers.org listings) per search results only; their pages were not fetched.
Quickstart guide at seranking.com/api/data/quickstart-guide returned 404; Data API header format rests on the OpenAPI repo.
Rate limit numbers (10 rps Data, 5 rps Project) come only from a mirrored README, not from official docs.
Trial length and whether API access is included during the free trial are unknown; 'Start with 100K free credits' appeared on the MCP page but was not verified in detail.
Write endpoints: Project API management suggests writes, but no official write operation list was confirmed.
